First public educational release of QuantChapter Returns Lab.

This release provides typed, dependency-free return, growth, volatility, and
drawdown calculations, strict CSV input, a local JSON report command, synthetic
data, and worked notebooks. Read the repository documentation for units,
estimation conventions, input restrictions, and floating-point limitations.

The release workflow runs the test matrix, quality checks, notebook execution,
dependency audit, build checks, and isolated wheel smoke test before publishing.
Attached distributions have SHA-256 digests and GitHub build-provenance
attestations. Check the linked Actions run for the actual outcomes.

This is pre-1.0 educational software. It does not establish learner validation,
investment performance, production adoption, or external certification.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/QuantChapter/quantchapter-returns-lab/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
and [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/QuantChapter/quantchapter-returns-lab/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
